apps.name: dsh-Go — dsh-go-1.2.0-ios-unsigned.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
**手机安装：只需下载 [`dsh-go-1.2.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-go-1.2.0-arm64.apk)。**

`update.json` 和 `SHA256SUMS` 供自动更新与校验使用，无需手动下载。GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 是源码包，不是安装包。

**Install on your phone: download [`dsh-go-1.2.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-go-1.2.0-arm64.apk).**

`update.json` and `SHA256SUMS` support automatic updates and verification. You do not need to download them manually. GitHub's Source code archives are not installers.

### 中文

- **iOS 版（测试）。** 这一版起提供未签名的 iOS 安装包 `dsh-go-1.2.0-ios-unsigned.ipa`，需要用爱思助手、AltStore 等工具自己签名后安装。用免费 Apple ID 签名时 Bundle ID 会被改掉，部分能力（如 Siri、分享扩展、后台）可能用不了。iOS 版只在少数真机上试过，问题请开 issue。
- **鸿蒙版合入主线。** 鸿蒙版的代码已经和安卓、iOS 共用一套，这一版暂时不提供 HAP 安装包，签名就绪后再补到这个版本下。
- **酒馆。** 酒馆助手的接口补齐，支持原生 MVU 变量；能把 DeepSeek 网页里聊不下去的对话导入酒馆接着聊；导入大卡和长聊天时明显不卡了。
- **让 AI 做一只宠物。** 宠物页新增「让 AI 做一只宠物」：带上自己的素材（GIF、逐帧图、Aseprite 导出或单张图），AI 会把它转成宠物包；转换时保留中文动画名，网页模式也能用。
- **按你问过的话搜索会话。** 会话搜索能搜到你自己问过的话和回复摘要，句子中间的中文词也能搜到。
- **手机操控确认改成三档**：允许一次、本轮允许、取消；设置里可以列一份「始终允许」的 App。停止只作用于当前这一轮，下一轮自动恢复。免确认模式下截图和点击不再弹卡。
- **长回复更流畅。** 长回复分块显示，流式输出时只重排最后一块。
- 其他改进：选 English 时 App 写给引擎的 AGENTS.md 也用英文；伙伴包的大小上限放宽，投稿失败会说清原因；桌面小组件的默认文字跟随 App 语言；跳过的版本换了更新源后也算跳过。
- **修复。** 安卓引擎在某些情况下重启被锁死；DeepSeek 的拒绝回复和无名错误被当成网络错误；生成图片时网关返回空链接导致图片丢失；首次 DNS 失败占用当天的生成额度；回合结束但没有答复时没有任何提示；Windows 主机的盘符路径和链接打不开、长文件名存不到手机；换启动画面或壁纸时旧文件被提前删掉；快速切换主机后最近会话停在上一个；未发出的草稿丢失；读屏无法点击详情页签和主题选项。
- **验证情况。** iOS 版和鸿蒙版都只在 CI 里编译并跑过模拟器测试，真机只做过零星试用；安卓版的新改动大部分只经过自动测试。遇到问题请导出诊断并开 issue。

### English

- **iOS (testing).** Starting with this version there is an unsigned iOS package, `dsh-go-1.2.0-ios-unsigned.ipa`, which you sign yourself with a tool such as AltStore before installing. Signing with a free Apple ID changes the bundle ID, and some features (such as Siri, the share extension and background work) may not be available. The iOS version has only been tried on a few real devices; please open an issue if something goes wrong.
- **HarmonyOS joins the main line.** The HarmonyOS code now shares one code base with Android and iOS. This version doesn't ship a HAP yet; it will be added to this release once signing is ready.
- **Tavern.** The Tavern Helper interfaces are complete, with native MVU variables; conversations that ran out of room on the DeepSeek website can be imported into Tavern and continued; importing large cards and long chats no longer stutters.
- **Have the AI make a pet.** The pets page has a new Have the AI make a pet entry: bring your own art (GIFs, frame sequences, Aseprite exports or a single image) and the AI turns it into a pet pack; Chinese animation names are kept, and it works in web mode too.
- **Search chats by what you asked.** Chat search finds your own questions and reply summaries, including Chinese words in the middle of a sentence.
- **Phone control confirmation has three choices**: allow once, allow for this turn, or cancel, and Settings can keep a list of always-allowed apps. Stop only applies to the current turn; the next turn starts fresh. Screenshots and taps no longer show a card when confirmation is off.
- **Smoother long replies.** Long replies are rendered in blocks, and while streaming only the last block is laid out again.
- Other improvements: with English selected, the AGENTS.md the app writes for the engine is in English too; companion pack size limits are looser and failed submissions say why; the home screen widget's default text follows the app language; a skipped version stays skipped after switching update source.
- **Fixes.** The Android engine getting stuck on restart in some cases; DeepSeek refusals and unnamed errors being reported as network errors; images lost when the gateway returned an empty link; a first DNS failure using up the day's generation budget; no notice when a turn ended without an answer; drive-letter paths and links from Windows hosts not opening, and long file names not saving to the phone; the old file being deleted too early when changing the launch screen or wallpaper; recent chats sticking to the previous host after switching quickly; unsent drafts being lost; screen readers not being able to tap detail tabs and theme options.
- **Testing.** The iOS and HarmonyOS versions have only been compiled and run on simulators in CI, with only occasional tries on real devices; most of the new Android changes have only been checked by automated tests. If you run into a problem, please export diagnostics and open an issue.

apps.name: YumEdit — YumEdit-1.3.1-b17-unsigned.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
# YumEdit 1.3.1 (build 17)

相较于 1.2.1：

- 重做旧机型开启流程：先写入美区销售字段、SiriMode、生成式模型能力和三处已知 CacheData 槽位。临时伪装 ProductType 由用户选择；下载完成后，可从同设备可信历史备份恢复真实机型，保留能力与区域字段。已写入能力值的设备仍可进入两阶段页面补做临时伪装。
- 对扩图能力字段异常提供检测与修正入口；恢复真实机型后突出提示不要进入「设置 → Siri」。
- 主入口不再限定国行和欧版；实验性机型伪装支持产品标识、板号、CPU、监管型号和销售地区组合，并在型号旁显示易读名称。无法核实目标监管型号时拒绝写入。
- 补齐旧 iPad 机型识别、调整主页纵向布局，在信息按钮上直接显示版本和构建号，并更新界面翻译。

IPA 未签名；签名时须保留 App Group 权限。旧机型两阶段及部分实验性功能的最终效果尚需更多真机验证。写入前请备份整机，每阶段写入后完整重启。

## English

Compared with 1.2.1, this release redesigns the older-device flow. It writes US sales fields, SiriMode, generative-model capability and three known CacheData slots. Temporary ProductType spoofing is optional; after resource download, the real model can be restored from a verified backup of the same device while preserving capability and region fields. Devices that already have the capability fields can still enter the flow and choose temporary spoofing.

It also adds detection and repair for two anomalous Photos capability values, a prominent warning against opening Settings → Siri after restoring the real model, broader region eligibility, a guarded advanced spoofing form, more iPad identifiers, improved layout, visible version/build information and updated translations.

The IPA is unsigned and requires App Group entitlement when signed. Back up the device and reboot after each write. Final behavior of the older-device flow and some experimental options needs further device testing.

apps.name: Erosion-CN — Erosion_v1.0.5_Bilingual.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
## Erosion-CN v1.0.5 (Build 30)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Fixed Unresponsive "Clean Selected" in Container Cache Cleaner (`CacheCleanerView`) / 修复容器缓存「一键清理已选」不生效** *(Thanks to [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) for reporting [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53) / 感谢 [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) 反馈 [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53))*
   - **Separated Button Styles in Overview Card**：Assigned `.borderless` to **Rescan** (`重新扫描`) and promoted **Clean Selected** (`一键清理已选`) to a full-width `.borderedProminent` button snapshotting targets prior to confirmation, eliminating SwiftUI `List` multi-button tap hijacking.
   - **Prevented Row Hit-Box Hijacking**：Replaced inline `NavigationLink` on **Inspect** (`查看`) with a `.borderless` button + `.navigationDestination(item:)` so tapping row checkboxes or **Clean** (`清理`) never triggers accidental navigation.
   - **Ad-Sentinel Protection & Re-Sized Refresh**：Unified scan/purge traversal depth (`Library/Caches` depth `7`, `tmp` depth `6`), skipped `.erosion_adlock` anti-recreate ad folders during cleanup, and updated remaining bytes / auth failure reporting accurately after purge.

2. **Explicit Read-Only & Sentinel State in `InfoViewer` / 文件详情页只读与防重建状态提示**
   - When a directory or file is already at `0555` / `0444`, the **Set Read-Only** preset button now automatically disables and displays `Already Read-Only` (`当前已是只读锁死状态`) or `Read-Only & Sentinel Active` (`当前已是只读防重建锁死状态`) alongside an `Anti-Recreate Lock` row (`Active (.erosion_adlock)`).
   - **Restore Read-Write** and **Apply** buttons disable when permissions already match, and restoring write permission on a sentinel directory from `InfoViewer` cleanly unlinks `.erosion_adlock`.

3. **Target Highlighting & Auto-Scroll on Ad Locator (`FileBrowserView` / `AdCacheBlockerView`) / 去广告「定位」自动高亮与居中定位**
   - Tapping **Locate** (`定位`) in Splash Ad Blocker now highlights the target ad folder/config inside its parent directory and scrolls smoothly to center it, with read-only sandbox grants for locator browsing and container grants ordered prior to `lstat` attribute checks.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

### Install & Checksum / 下载安装与校验

- **SideStore / AltStore / Feather Official Source / 官方更新源**：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/main/apps.json` *(auto-synced by CI after release / 发版后由 GitHub Actions 自动同步)*
- **IPA Asset / 安装包文件**：`Erosion_v1.0.5_Bilingual.ipa` (`6,875,541` bytes; preserve `App Group` entitlements when signing)
- **SHA-256**：`408c50a9bbb2a84ece90393875bab5d7240f02e784e7a34aaa4d61d7a44a41c3`

apps.name: WQFiles — WQFiles.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.18

Your own inspectors, your own cleaning targets, and Japanese.

## New

- **Custom inspectors** ([#45](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/45)): small JavaScript programs that show a file's contents your way. Long-press a file → **Open As → Custom Inspector…**. WQ Files ships only the runtime; the inspectors are yours.
  - **Install:** open a `.zip` holding an inspector with WQ Files (share sheet, AirDrop, Files app), or copy its folder into **Settings → Inspectors**. Installing one with the same name again updates it.
  - **Write one:** a folder with `manifest.json` and `inspect.js`. The script gets the file as bytes, as text and, for property lists, already parsed, and returns sections with rows or text. A `data.json` can hold your own lookup tables. Two examples and the full format are in the [README](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#custom-inspectors).
  - **Results:** tap a value to copy it; Share sends everything as text. Script errors show with their line number.
  - **Safe by design:** inspectors only read. A script has no access to other files, the network or the app, and is stopped after 2 seconds.
- **Your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner:** long-press a folder or file inside an app's data → **Add to Cache Cleaner**. Instagram, for example, keeps uploaded videos in `Library/Application Support/Instagram/VideoUpload` long after they're posted.
  - Choose **Always Select** (selected after every scan and by Select All, like caches) or **Select by Hand** (you pick it each time). Long-press it in the Cache Cleaner to switch **Select Automatically** later, or to take it off the list.
  - A folder is emptied (the folder itself stays), a file is deleted.
  - Only add what the app can do without: anything it keeps there (drafts, downloads, logins) is gone once cleaned. The app's settings folders can't be added.
  - Saved per app, so it keeps working when the app moves to a new container.
- **Japanese** ([#69](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/pull/69)), the 14th language. Thanks to kinboy56.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

SHA-256 of WQFiles.ipa: `177b383c541f6deb04db331a8c7b5ed3ba8f574d85e24a72cb867f3699550a18`

apps.name: Husk — Husk.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

apps.name: ipadn — iPadn-2.2.1-lite-unsigned.ipa
apps.versionDescription:
## iPadn 2.2.1

本次版本重点修复开启「专业模式」时白屏与无法重进设置页、搜索结果偶现重复条目、「Wi‑Fi 传输」大包 30 秒断流等体验问题，并同步完成全仓导航栈、外部链接确认、磁盘空间清理与 `FairPlayCore` 流式解密边界安全加固。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

### 修复与稳定性提升

- **修复专业模式白屏与子页面导航**：将底部标签切换统一绑定到语义化 `TabID`，修复开启或关闭「专业模式」时标签数组变化引发的白屏、设置页失联及退出专业模式时的导航监听循环；将「账号」与「应用包」导航栈升级为异构 `NavigationPath`，确保「本机应用 › 应用详情」、「历史版本来源」编辑页、「安装包信息」与「浏览安装包内容」深层进退稳定可靠。
- **修复搜索偶现重复应用与下架状态串染**：对单区/多区商店搜索、本地索引与「更多结果」执行 `trackId` 及 `bundleID` 双重保序去重，合并最完整图标与体积元数据；防止本地旧缓存的已下架标记覆盖实时重新上架结果，并兼容 Apple Arcade 与 tvOS 实体核验。
- **修复「Wi‑Fi 传输」满 30 秒断连**：将 30 秒连接超时严格限制在 HTTP 请求头读取阶段，进入安装包流式传输后立即解除计时，避免大体积 IPA 局域网下载中途断流。
- **修复弹窗吞没、空间残留与边界崩溃**：修复「下载 › + › 通过链接下载」及备份/证书选择器收起动画期间吞没后续弹窗的问题；删除下载任务与启动时自动清理 `tmp/Share` 硬链接及残留临时导出文件，释放磁盘空间；修复灵动岛倒计时跨零崩溃、「应用包」页文件变动强制解包、备份导入覆盖商店地区竞态、无锁屏密码设备导入备份锁死、冷启动误触发自动解密、Mac `.pkg` 过期签名链接重试及根页面顶栏标题过渡。

### 安全与本机解密加固

- **`FairPlayCore` 流式解密与 64 位边界校验**：将加密段解密升级为 4 MB 页对齐流式窗口，超大二进制解密堆内存峰值降至固定 8 MB；补齐 Mach-O 加载命令 64 位无溢出边界、4 字节对齐、`O_NOFOLLOW`、`FAT_64`/`ZIP64` 偏移及截断压缩流防护，并将文件日志写入改为可捕获 Swift `FileHandle` 接口以防空间不足时异常闪退。
- **归档路径包含与外部链接确认**：严格拦截畸形归档多斜杠（`///..`）路径穿越、越界相对符号链接及 `Manifest.plist` `SinfPaths` 越界复制；外部 `ipadn://` 下载链接新增来源域名与完整地址确认弹窗、应用锁状态暂存及本机回环地址拦截，且外部直链安装包下载完成后不静默触发自动安装；开启应用锁时执行「恢复默认设置」需先验证身份。
- **诊断文案免误杀与 11 语言同步**：优化解密失败映射与脱敏规则，识别 `EACCES`/`EPERM` 授权错误并完整保留中文排障指引，同步更新全部 11 种界面语言。
- 继续支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本（各功能保留各自系统版本要求）。

### 两个安装包

- `iPadn-2.2.1-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动（灵动岛、锁屏进度）与桌面小组件扩展，签名需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.2.1-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，移除扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能完全一致。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可添加源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`。

### English

This release fixes a Pro mode white-screen / Settings navigation regression, intermittent duplicate search results, and a 30-second Wi‑Fi transfer cutoff on large IPAs, alongside comprehensive navigation, storage, external URL, and `FairPlayCore` streaming security hardening.

- **Pro mode & deep navigation fixes**: Binds root tab selection to semantic `TabID` values and upgrades the Account and Packages stacks to heterogeneous `NavigationPath`, resolving white screens when toggling Pro mode, preserving Settings re-entry without `onChange` loops, and keeping Installed Apps › App Detail, Version Source Editor, Package Info, and Package Contents sub-routes working reliably.
- **Search deduplication & delisted accuracy**: Deduplicates single-region, multi-region, local-index, and More Results entries by both `trackId` and normalized `bundleID` while merging richer artwork/version metadata and preventing stale cached delisted flags from overriding live storefront listings.
- **Wi‑Fi transfer & lifecycle reliability**: Cancels the 30-second header timeout as soon as HTTP headers arrive so large IPA browser downloads never drop mid-stream; defers stacked alerts/sheets until dismissal completes; sweeps `tmp/Share` APFS hard links on job deletion and launch; fixes Live Activity zero-crossing ranges, backup storefront/passcode-less edge cases, cold-launch auto-decrypt seeding, Mac `.pkg` retry URL refresh, and Liquid Glass root header transitions.
- **Security & FairPlay streaming hardening**: Switches `FairPlayCore` slice decryption to 4 MB page-aligned streaming windows (`8 MB` peak heap), hardens 64-bit Mach-O / `FAT_64` / `ZIP64` / truncated-deflate bounds and throwing `FileHandle` writes, blocks `///..` multi-slash Zip-Slip and out-of-bundle `SinfPaths` / symlinks, gates external `ipadn://` download links behind user confirmation (deferring while App Lock is active and never auto-installing untrusted URLs), and preserves localized `EACCES`/`EPERM` guidance across all 11 languages.

- **修复搜索偶现重复应用与下架状态串染**：对单区/多区商店搜索、本地索引与「更多结果」执行 `trackId` 及 `bundleID` 双重保序去重，合并最完整图标与体积元数据；防止本地旧缓存的已下架标记覆盖实时重新上架结果，并兼容 Apple Arcade 与 tvOS 实体核验。
- **修复「Wi‑Fi 传输」满 30 秒断连**：将 30 秒连接超时严格限制在 HTTP 请求头读取阶段，进入安装包流式传输后立即解除计时，避免大体积 IPA 局域网下载中途断流。
- **修复弹窗吞没、空间残留与边界崩溃**：修复「下载 › + › 通过链接下载」及备份/证书选择器收起动画期间吞没后续弹窗的问题；删除下载任务与启动时自动清理 `tmp/Share` 硬链接及残留临时导出文件，释放磁盘空间；修复灵动岛倒计时跨零崩溃、「应用包」页文件变动强制解包、备份导入覆盖商店地区竞态、无锁屏密码设备导入备份锁死、冷启动误触发自动解密、Mac `.pkg` 过期签名链接重试及根页面顶栏标题过渡。

apps.versionDescription:
## WHAT IS CHANGE
本次更新重点改善播放响应与多集连播体验，并持续补齐部分插件宿主能力。

- 播放与连播优化：减少重复请求，复用网络连接；提前准备下一集并预取部分媒体数据，让自动连播、手动选集和滑动切集更顺畅。
- 播放状态修正：修复加载过程中偶尔显示为暂停的问题，改善切集时的状态反馈。
- 手动检查更新：在「设置 → 关于」检查 GitHub Release。有新版本时可打开对应发布页面，自行下载安装；暂不提供自动检查或内置更新。
- 播放能力探测：根据当前设备 WebView 的能力与实际播放路径识别格式、编码支持情况，统一插件播放、预加载和刷新时的能力信息。
- 补齐 RSA 加密接口：支持 SPKI / PKCS#1 公钥、PKCS1 / OAEP-SHA1 / OAEP-SHA256 填充，以及 1024–8192 位密钥。
- 插件开发资料同步：更新协议说明、支持状态、开发文档与 Agent 技能包。


## 初期版本说明
HGhub 目前处于初期开发阶段，功能和插件接口仍在完善，使用过程中可能遇到问题，欢迎反馈。

**iOS、macOS 安装包尚未验证可用性。提供构建产物仅供尝试，不代表已完成安装、启动或播放验证。**

## 下载说明
- Windows：安装版 `.exe` 或便携版 `_portable.zip`。
- Android：根据设备架构选择签名 `.apk`。
- macOS（可用性未验证）：选择 `arm64`、`x64` 或 `universal` 的 `.dmg` / `.app.tar.gz`。
- iOS（可用性未验证）：`_ios.ipa` 为未签名包，需要通过 TrollStore 或自行签名安装。
- Linux：`.deb` 或 `.AppImage`。

macOS 构建未经过 Apple 开发者证书签名及公证；若系统拦截，请确认来源后执行：
```bash
sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/HGhub.app
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Minireel/HGhub/compare/v0.0.1...v0.0.2
